subject: Q4 upside clean-up: lock expansion commits & CRM hygiene
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Sarah Lopez <s.lopez@acmemed.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q4 upside clean-up: lock expansion commits & CRM hygiene

Team — quick one as we head into commit reviews next week. We have a handful of expansion opportunities in Q4 tied to CS-driven adoption plays (Acme Medical included). Finance asked that we lock down committed ARR and ensure stage dates in HubSpot are accurate by EOD next Thursday so the commit meeting has clean numbers.

As the owner on several of these, I need help from CS to confirm customer intent and exact committed ARR:
- Acme Medical (Sarah/Tom) — expansion for user seats + premium support; current CRM amount: $240k upside (stage: Proposal).
- Two other customers are lower probability and listed in the tracker.

Actions: can CS confirm a committed number (or a firm no) for Acme by Tue 11/4? If yes, please update the deal record and ping Finance. Ethan — can you flag anything you need from my side for the commit call? I've attached the latest tracker and a small CSV with deal line items.

Attachments: Q4_upside_tracker.xlsx (sheet: Acme details), Acme_commit_matrix.csv

Thanks — trying to avoid noisy ask at close.

—Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Sarah Lopez <s.lopez@acmemed.com>, Tom Guerrero <t.guerrero@acmemed.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 upside clean-up: lock expansion commits & CRM hygiene

Neha — thanks for the heads up. I'll take point on Acme. Quick context: CS has been running a 6-week pilot of the seat expansion with their clinical analytics group; adoption metrics look strong but the procurement timeline is still pending legal (they want a two-week review). I can surface a firm commit but need a short confirmation from procurement.

Plan: I will reach out to Tom and Sarah today and ask for a hard yes/no by Tue 11/4 EOD. If they confirm, I'll update HubSpot and add a note in the deal timeline (and copy Finance). If procurement pushes, I'll log it as a sales-accepted risk (move to Commit-Review with expected close date).

Also: please put any product/price changes in the attachments so I can hand them to the customer without ambiguity.

—Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Neha/Monica — heads up on a couple finance items for commit hygiene:
1) When CS confirms a commit, we need the committed ARR broken down by billing cadence (annual vs. quarterly) and the exact start date for revenue recognition.
2) For pivoted deals (e.g., smaller seat count than quoted), update the deal amount and add a note with who authorized it.

If Acme confirms, please add the purchase order or signed email to the HubSpot timeline and cc finance@redwood.com. I'll pull the updated commit list Wednesday morning and circulate the pre-meeting deck.

Thanks — Ethan
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
ethan.park@redwood.com

Monica — appreciate it. Two quick clarifications from my end:
- If procurement signs off but wants a delayed start date (e.g., Jan 1), I'd still count that as committed for our Q4 commit if the customer signs before our close window (Finance prefers signed intent > our cutoff). Please flag if that's a problem.
- Acme's quoted split is $180k annual seats + $60k premium support (total $240k). If they opt for quarterly billing that reduces FY recognized ARR this year — Ethan, I'll make sure billing cadence is explicit in HubSpot.

I'm looping Rishi for visibility in the commit call prep. I'll be on standby to jump into the procurement thread with CS if needed.

—Neha
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Update and commit: Acme confirmed via email this afternoon. Sarah (copied) authorized the expansion and procurement signed off on contract language with a start date of 2026-01-01. They want annual billing.

Summary for Finance / Commit:
- Account: Acme Medical
- Committed ARR: $240,000
- Billing cadence: Annual
- Revenue start date: 2026-01-01 (signed PO on file; uploaded to HubSpot timeline)
- HubSpot: Deal stage set to "Commit-Review" with close date 2025-12-15; note added: "Procurement signed; start date deferred to Jan 1, 2026 per customer request."

I've uploaded the signed email and the updated line items to the deal (HubSpot link in thread). Ethan — let me know if you'd prefer that we record this as Q4 commit or as Post-Close deferred start; I followed Finance guidance and marked as commit but noted the start date.

Attachments: Q4_upside_tracker.xlsx (updated), Acme_signed_email.eml (stub)
